sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Có thuốc say xe không? is the phrase to keep ready for "Do you have motion sickness medicine" in doctors, pharmacies, symptoms, and medication. This is for when travel motion is the problem and you want the medicine, not a doctor. Useful for buses, ferries, and mountain travel. It works best when you focus on letting the other person answer yes, no, or point you to the right option. After you say it, listen for a yes/no answer, a gesture toward the item, or a short alternative; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.
